analysis:
Integration across all 31 units found no supported regression. The PR hardens the TB-012 add-on hold surface (A-018, T-059, new T-060) with docs, threat-model text and a small set of Swift changes. The units I could check:

- AddonHoldStore.read and LifecycleMailbox.read (line 81) add O_NONBLOCK next to the existing O_NOFOLLOW and fstat regular-file, owner and mode checks. A same-UID FIFO at those paths is refused instead of blocking the provider.
- AddonIPCServer verifies the peer's audit token at accept, before the connection takes one of 8 slots, and keeps re-verification on each request. It adds a 10 s request-line deadline. Accept-thread serialization of verification and refusal is a documented accepted residual (T-060), not a regression.
- addonHoldLoadRefusal fences loads in ensureModelLoaded (head lines 396, 576, 711, 945), loadNemotronSuperSlot (46, 170) and requireNativeMiMoPublication (251). Throws occur before the load gate is taken, or flow through the existing unwind and release paths, so the gate and reslice-gate state does not visibly leak.
- persistLoadedModelSet (StartupPreload.swift:106) skips writes while addonHoldActive. The plan holds only advertised model IDs, so this is an availability and state-staleness matter.
- ProviderLoop.swift lines 493-502 add a settle timeout and an internal, nil-in-production test hook.
- cancelRequestsOutlivingAddonHoldDrain cancels only coordinator requests it found running, and stops on release.

Residual questions for human review:
- The definitions of addonHoldLoadRefusal, addonHoldActive (is it cleared on every release and crash path?) and isLoadingAny were not supplied. A load that never unwinds keeps a hold in draining. This is documented, fail-closed and availability-only.
- DARKBLOOM_ADDON_SOCKET is honored in every build. The docs say the LaunchAgent does not pass it. Whether a same-UID process can redirect a foreground or CLI-started provider is existing behavior and is unverified.
- The docs and YAML cite T-060 and security/local-control.md. The canonical index stops at T-059, but the PR's docs/threat-model.yaml adds T-060, so this is not a dangling reference. The YAML hunks are truncated, so the T-060 and TB-012 prose was not fully verified against code.
- Several ModelLoading hunks (942-948, 1041-1048) are truncated.
- The coordinator's handling of the self-reported busy fields is platform-owned and out of scope.
